title: Nestor’s plan; Troy’s assembly
intro: Nestor proposes a truce to burn the dead and build a wall and ditch. Meanwhile the Trojans assemble.

notes.text: νῶτον, back / chine cut; διηνεκής, unbroken, full-length: dat pl; dat of means.
γεραίρω, honour: 3sg impf; Ajax gets the best cut.
ἥρως, hero; κρείων, ruling: pres ptc; εὐρύ adverbial, “wide-ruling.”
πόσις, drink; ἐδητύς, food: gen, with ἔρον.
ἵημι, send: 3pl 2aor mid ἕντο; tmesis ἐξ … ἕντο, “drove out desire,” i.e. satisfied hunger.
πάμπρωτος, first of all; ὑφαίνω, weave; μῆτις, counsel: acc; ἄρχομαι, begin: 3sg impf.
οὗ, whose: gen, with βουλή; πρόσθεν, formerly; φαίνετο, appeared.
ἐυφρονέω, be well-meaning: pres ptc, uncontracted; σφιν, to them.
ἀγοράομαι, speak in assembly: 3sg aor; μετεῖπον, spoke among.
Πανάχαιοι, all the Achaeans: gen pl.
θνῄσκω, die: 3pl perf, “lie dead.”
κελαινός, dark; εὔρροος, fair-flowing: epithet of Scamander, here modifies blood.
σκεδάννυμι, scatter / spill: 3sg aor; ὀξύς, keen; Ἄρης as a name for war.
-δε, to: “to Hades”; κατέρχομαι, go down: 3pl 2aor; ψυχαί, spirits.
τώ, therefore; χρή + acc and inf, “you must.”
ἠώς, dawn: dat; παύω, make cease: aor inf (transitive) with πόλεμον.
ἀγείρω, gather: aor mid ptc nom pl, syncopated; “we ourselves assemble.”
κυκλέω, bring round / wheel: 1pl aor subj or fut, epic -ο- vowel; νεκρούς, bodies.
βοῦς, ox; ἡμίονος, mule: dat pl of means (carts).
κατακαίω, burn: 1pl aor subj, epic -ομεν.
τυτθός, a little; πρὸ νεῶν, in front of the ships; ἀπό adverbial, away.
ὀστέον, bone; ἄγω: 3sg pres subj, purpose; each man takes the bones home to the children.
νέομαι, return: 1pl pres subj; πατρίδα γαῖαν, fatherland.
χέω, heap up: 1pl aor subj; ἐξάγω, lead out: 2aor ptc; ἕνα τύμβον, one mound.
ἄκριτος, undivided / common; ποτί = πρός; αὐτόν, the mound.
δέμω, build: 1pl aor subj; ὠκέως, quickly.
πύργος, tower; εἶλαρ, shelter / protection: in apposition.
πύλη, gate; ποιέω: 1pl fut; ἀραρίσκω, fit: perf ptc fem pl, “well-fitted.”
αὐτάων = αὐτῶν, epic gen pl fem; ἱππηλασίη, for driving horses; ὁδός, road.
ἔκτοσθεν, outside; ὀρύσσω, dig: 1pl fut; τάφρος, ditch; ἐγγύθι, near.
ἐρύκω, keep off: 3sg reduplicated 2aor opt (ἐρυκάκοι), potential; ἀμφὶς ἐοῦσα, lying around it.
ἐπιβρίθω, press upon: 3sg aor subj, fear clause; ἀγερωχος, proud / haughty.
ἐπαινέω, approve: 3pl aor.
ἀγορή, assembly; γίγνομαι: 3sg 2aor; ἄκρη, citadel: dat sg fem.
τρηχύνω, make rough: perf ptc nom fem, “stormy / tumultuous.”
παρά + dat, beside; θύρη, door: dat pl; the doors of Priam’s palace.
πέπνυμαι, be wise: perf ptc; ἄρχω, begin: 3sg impf, + inf ἀγορεύειν.
